content.markdown: Ten kinds are used: `NpmPackage`, `Module`, `Interface`, `Class`, `Field`, `Function`, `ReactComponent`, `Property`, `Constant`, and `Concept`. Interface members are documented within `content` rather than as separate entries. Class members receive separate subentries. Methods reuse `Function`; the full name `Property` avoids ambiguity with Lean’s `Prop = Proposition`; and default implementations reuse `Constant`.
